title: Log4Shell Remote Code Execution in Apache Log4j
description: Apache Log4j2 2.0-beta9 through 2.15.0 JNDI features used in configuration, log messages, and parameters do not protect against attacker controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints.

title: runc Container Breakout via Workdir Leaked File Descriptor
description: In runc 1.1.11 and earlier, process.cwd can be configured to point to a file descriptor path in /proc/self/fd, allowing attackers to escape container sandbox.

title: Libwebp Heap Buffer Overflow in WebP Image Processing
description: Heap buffer overflow in WebP in Google Chrome prior to 116.0.5845.187 allowed remote attacker to perform out-of-bounds memory write via a crafted HTML page.

title: Prototype Pollution in Lodash Template Parser
description: Lodash before 4.17.21 allows prototype pollution via template function with user-controlled input properties.

title: Spring4Shell Remote Code Execution in Spring Framework
description: A Spring MVC or Spring WebFlux application running on JDK 9+ may be vulnerable to remote code execution via data binding.
